slides.title: Apne notes se *AI tutor* banao
slides.subtitle: Pandit ji ka Tool: Gemini Notebook (notebooklm.google).

slides.title: Gemini *Notebook*
slides.body: A Google tool where you add your own sources and ask questions about them. Its answers are grounded in the information you provide.

slides.title: Kahan se *start* karein?
slides.body: Not sure where to begin? The site has featured public notebooks you can explore first.

slides.title: Data ka *kya*?
slides.body: The site says that for individual users, your data is not used for training unless you share feedback.

slides.title: Kaam ka laga?
slides.text: Har hafte naye AI tools, students ke liye.
